definition:
flowchart LR
  Start([Request]) --> Auth[Authenticate]
  Auth --> Cache{Cache hit?}
  Cache -->|hit| Serve[Serve cached]
  Cache -->|miss| Fetch[Fetch from origin]
  Fetch --> Store[(Write cache)]
  Store --> Serve
  Serve --> Done([Response])
  classDef nocturne fill:#1e1e1e,stroke:#2a2a2a,stroke-width:1px,color:#eceff4
  class Start,Auth,Cache,Serve,Fetch,Store,Done nocturne
  linkStyle default stroke:#3a3a3a,stroke-width:1px
intent: HARDCODED DARK PALETTE that must survive LIGHT theme - exact mirror of w3-09 on the same graph. Fills #1e1e1e, strokes #2a2a2a, text #eceff4, edges #3a3a3a. These are the plugin's OWN dark-theme values (wave 1 read #1e1e1e canvas and #eceff4 text out of the enhancer), so this asks what happens when a user hardcodes the dark theme's palette into a light-theme page: the #2a2a2a stroke on a #1e1e1e fill is 1.19:1 in EITHER theme, an unconditional defect independent of theme. All computable.
